entries.condition: printed in the served report's Appendix B as the lead of the tool effects block, after the isolation block inside the disclosure block, when the disclosure record holds an effects part and effects_lines gives a line; a record stored without the part prints none

the lead of the line naming the tools a declaration states run the sample's code natively, and of the line for under emulation (executes_from declared, or a row stored before it), whose record does not hold the run: a declared when, or a row stored before calls were counted by how they ended (no completed field), with a call taken as completed
basis: effects row executes, executes_from, completed, when, calls

entries.condition: the lead of the line naming the tools, other than those declared to do none of the three, with a call not run, refused or failed, one line for each of the three in that order

the lead of the line naming the tools a declaration states run the sample's code natively, and of the line for under emulation (executes_from declared, or a row stored before it), each with a counted completed call (the row's completed) and no declared when: a completed call of a tool whose declared work is running the code is that run
basis: effects row executes, executes_from, completed, when

entries.condition: the lead of the lines naming the tools with a completed call a declaration states reach only the sandbox service their server fronts, the configured case-memory store, or the network only to fetch or refresh reference data they keep (network_from declared, or a row stored before it: a named mode is only ever a declaration's); the case-memory store with where the disclosure's case-memory row places it (_STORE_PLACED, _STORE_UNPLACED, _STORE_NONE); each tool with its declared when
basis: effects row network, network_from, network_by, when, completed

entries.condition: the lead of the lines naming the tools with a completed call that reach the network (network true), one line per origin as network_from records it: declared (a declaration states it); taken, as a tool declared or taken to send the hash out, declared to send the bytes to a third party, or taken to send the file out (rows the cautious answer forced, the hash and bytes by third_party_from); taken (the platform read it, a row stored before network_from, or an origin this code does not know); stated by its server's own declaration its block does not trust; said by its server's own hint
basis: effects row network, network_from, network_by, third_party, third_party_from, completed

entries.condition: after the case-memory store lead, where the record lists no store row (the store kept in the process or not configured)
after the case-memory store lead, where a store row of the record is placed (local or outside) with a host
after the case-memory store lead, where the record lists a store row and none is placed with a host

the lead of the lines naming the tools with a completed call whose named network (the sandbox service their server fronts, the configured case-memory store, the network only for reference data) the platform read rather than a declaration stated (network_from any value but declared); the case-memory store with where the disclosure's case-memory row places it; each tool with its declared when
basis: effects row network, network_from, when, completed

entries.condition: the lead of the line naming the tools with a completed call whose running of the sample's code natively, or under emulation, the platform read of the tool's listing or program (executes_from read, or any value but declared), never said as a run; each tool with its declared when and where its source read the sample
basis: effects row executes, executes_from, completed, when

entries.condition: named in the undeclared line of a tool with a completed or failed call whose declaration leaves executes unset
named in the undeclared line of a tool with a completed or failed call whose network is answered by no declaration, statement or hint
named in the undeclared line of a tool with a completed or failed call whose declaration leaves third_party unset
beside a tool in a line on reaching the network whose server's own openWorldHint is false: that the hint says it does not reach outside its server; nothing otherwise

names where each tool was called through in every line of the block: a server that recorded no source, the platform's own tools, an in-process source by its declared label (or as the in-process source), a tool server, a provider's tool server, any other source

beside a tool in the not-run, refused or failed line when that count is not every call of the tool: the count of all its calls, with the steps never run and, for a refusal, the answers served, counted by the row's shape
basis: effects row calls, served, not_run, refused, failed

entries.condition: beside a tool in a line on reaching the network or on sending the hash whose declaration says it answers offline when given no credentials: that declaration, as declared; nothing otherwise

beside a tool in the ran-the-sample's-code lines: where the isolation part placed its source's read (no read recorded, the worker process, a started process kept by measurement, kept by a declared launcher or not shown kept, a local server, outside this machine, or untold)

beside a tool in the lines on the sandbox service its server fronts: at a host the disclosure places on this machine (the operator's own), at a host outside it, or that where it went cannot be told, with the disclosure's reason or that the record does not say

the tool effects block of the served report's Appendix B for a disclosure record with an effects part: the line that the part may be incomplete where a partial reason is recorded; that no tool call was recorded; or, for tools with a completed call, each effect in the voice of where it came from: running the sample's code (ran where a declaration states it and a counted call completed under no declared when, declared to run otherwise, taken as running where the platform read it, executes_from), the sandbox leads declared or taken, the network by where each answer came from (_REACHES) and in a named mode (_REACHED, _TAKEN_REACHED, the case-memory store placed only where a store row of the record is placed with a host), the hash declared or taken as sent (third_party_from declared, else taken: read, stored before the field, unknown), the bytes declared sent or handed to the sandbox a server fronts where a declaration states them, else the file taken as handed or sent out of the deployment, each tool with its declared when and offline condition, then the tools declared or taken to do none, server hints and statements, the calls that did not complete, and the questions left open with the reason its declaration or the platform's reading of its listing gives (why_from); [] for a record without the part
basis: disclosure.effects partial_reason, tools (each row's counts, answers, network_from, third_party_from, executes_from, why_from, when, offline_without_credentials, hints)
